Transitive development dependency; the pin holds the floor above the command-injection advisory.

Four high advisories landed against fast-uri 3.0.0-3.1.5, all host-confusion or SSRF through URL normalisation. It reaches this tree only as web-ext -> addons-linter -> ajv, so nothing it parses is user input, but the pin costs nothing and npm reported a non-breaking fix. The 4.x line is a major bump ajv does not ask for.
resolutionOverrides.recheckBecause: Four separate normalisation bypasses shipped against the same parser inside one minor line, so 3.1.6 holding today is not evidence the class is closed.
